description: This file contains React hooks and functions for managing AI chat interactions within a roadmap application, including chat rendering, streaming responses, scroll management, and chat history handling.

methods.name: roadmapAIChatRenderer
methods.description: Creates a renderer object mapping chat message types to React components, configured with options like total topics, roadmap ID, and topic selection callback.

methods.name: useRoadmapAIChat
methods.description: Custom React hook managing AI chat state, streaming responses, scroll behavior, and chat history for a roadmap-based chat interface.

methods.name: htmlFromTiptapJSON
methods.description: Converts a Tiptap JSON content object into an HTML string, handling text, paragraphs, and variable spans.
